title: 第5章 老子是来修仙的你让我看守草药场第6章 炼气成功
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“今天到此为止了，不合格的都散了吧！”玄阳真人挥挥手，懒得再多瞧一眼，一招手，测灵台凭空消失。
“真是神仙手段，看到没，仙人这大手一挥，便可隔空取物，来无影去无踪！”远处看热闹的人群中叽叽喳喳。
“什么隔空取物，这叫空间转移，这测灵台肯定已经自行返回仙门了！”有人不屑的反驳。
玄阳真人听着他们胡扯，不禁莞尔，什么隔空取物空间转移，就是收紧了储物空间而已，这些没见过世面的土鳖，一刻也不想与他们多待。
“你们几个上来，本尊带你们回宗门！”玄阳真人召出飞剑，随手一挥，剑身不变，却有土黄色光芒延伸开来，仿佛增长了十倍的巨剑。
“仙师！且慢！”见玄阳真人这就要离开，苏星河赶忙叫道。
“嗯？你怎还不退去！”
虎子珠玉在前，苏星河勾起了他些许期望，不料这小子非但资质不好，连最差的下品灵根都达不到，反差之下，玄阳真人看他就不太顺眼了，此时又敢上前拦截，心下已是不耐，若不是看到刚挑选的新人苗子眼巴巴的看着，早就出手打发了。
“弟子既然能让这测灵石亮起，说明是有灵根的，还请仙师收了我吧！”苏星河纳头便拜，不经意间朝虎子猛使眼色，示意他开口求情。
虎子虽然木讷，却不傻，连忙与苏星河跪在一起。
“师傅！我兄弟二人，没爹没娘，孤苦无依，请您老家发发慈悲，收了他吧！”
听虎子说的这么凄惨，苏星河心下一喜，没看出来这小子平日里看着呆，关键时刻还是懂分寸的。
其实，这也不是虎子瞎说，都是实情，村子被灭后，这就是真实的处境。
“是啊！仙师，我三岁丧父，五岁没了娘，要不是虎子哥含辛茹苦将我抚养长大，我恐怕早就成了野兽的下酒菜了！”
“什么野兽的下酒菜，野兽还会喝酒？”天生绝美的李彩薇，噗嗤一下笑出声来。
“修仙不易，证道之路凶险非凡，你天资不够，即使入我仙门，也难有建树，修炼不比凡间习武，其中艰险难以想象，何不就在山下，虎子天资极好，将来稍稍照拂你一下，便是享不尽的荣华富贵！”玄阳伸手将虎子扶起，却没管苏星河，任由他跪着。
“爹娘走前，让我们兄弟要一生相伴，永不分离！我不能让爹娘心愿落空，这是大不孝！恳请仙师看在死者的份上，收了弟子吧！”苏星河用力挤出些许眼泪，声泪俱下的哭求。
“请师傅收下弟弟！”听着苏星河胡扯，虎子目瞪口呆，这读过书的人就是厉害，明明是胡扯，却让他都感动了。
“爷爷，要不就收了他吧，李二私吞灵草，被革出山门，正好缺人。”亭亭玉立的李彩薇搂着玄阳真人的袖袍摇了摇，亲昵道。
“也可，既然你铁了心要修行，看在采薇和虎子的份儿上，就给你个机会！”

“多谢仙师收留，弟子赴汤蹈火，万死不辞！”
苏星河一颗悬着的心，终于落了下来，虽然不知道哪里缺人，只要能进入宗门，就有机会。
这拜入仙门是复仇的基础，如果连仙门都进不去，何来的复仇一说，虽然表现有点卑微，没有实力之前就得藏着，掖着，想要脸面，以后再拼命挣回来就是了。
“马屁精！”一个不合时宜的稚童声音响起，苏星河侧头去看，却是名叫欧阳赫的马车少年，也是天赋最好的一个。
“有些麻烦啊！还没入门就得罪了天之骄子，往后的日子恐怕不好过了”。想起先前他恶毒的神情，苏星河心下有些忐忑，事已至此，只能走一步看一步了。
“行了都上来，我们准备回宗门了，亲人各自散去，等他们修炼有成，自然会有相见之日！”玄阳真人大袖一挥，长剑上凌厉气势收敛，朝几个被选中孩子亲人方向挥了挥手，就此一飞冲天，眨眼间消失不见，只留山顶一众看热闹的，几家欢喜几家愁。
飞剑虽说很稳，却是几个孩子，第一次御空飞行，看着脚下一望无际，都吓得大气不敢出，资质最好的欧阳赫，双腿不停哆嗦，这极品的资质也没起到半点作用，其他几个少年也是一样，反倒是苏星河和虎子，表现的更镇定些。
虎子常年出入山里狩猎，胆量自然不差，苏星河虽然没有进过山，却也是山村里摸爬滚打，况且前不久刚杀了两个人，胆量自然没的说。
“收摄心神，目视前方，不要胡思乱想！”
玄阳真人，目光在众人脸上略过，对虎子十分满意，虽然天资不是最好的，这份从容淡定却是难得，修仙艰难，天赋固然重要，但心性也至关重要，两者相辅相成，缺一不可。
不知飞了多久，众人眼前，显现出一片庞大的山脉，抬眼望去，又五座山峰相连，正中山峰最是挺拔，其余四峰众星拱月，环绕分布。
“前面就是我们的宗门千贺宗，共分为五峰，我们灵隐峰就在这里！”随着玄阳真人介绍时，飞剑朝最西侧的峰顶飞掠而去。
“玄阳师弟！”不等众人落地，突有声音传来，声音不大，比起呼啸的风声，更显微弱，却清晰传入众人口中。
“是掌门师伯！”李彩薇率先开口，惊讶的望着来人，身为一派掌门，平日里是很少现身的，更何况，是亲自来到灵隐峰。
“见过玄机师兄！”掌门号玄机。
“见过掌门师伯！”
“见过掌门！”
几人身份不同，称呼不同。
“师兄前来可是有事？”玄阳真人感觉不妙。
“哪位是极品灵根？”掌门脸色郑重。

“弟子欧阳赫。”之前八面玲珑的少年，可能御剑飞行吓到了，面对掌门，有点慌张。
“玄机师兄，我已将其收入关门弟子！”
听到掌门开口就询问资质最好的，玄阳真人心中已经了然，测灵石与宗门阵法相容，资质测试结果，第一时间就传回了宗门，掌门这是来抢人了。
content_en:
"That's it for today, let's get rid of all the unqualified ones!" Master Xuanyang waved his hand, not bothering to take another look. With a wave of his hand, the spirit detection platform disappeared out of thin air.
"It's really a magic trick. Did you see it? With a wave of his big hand, the immortal can take things from a distance and come and go without a trace!" chirped the crowd watching the excitement in the distance.
"What is retrieving objects from the air? This is called space transfer. This soul-detecting platform must have returned to the Immortal Sect on its own!" Someone retorted disdainfully.
Master Xuanyang listened to their nonsense and couldn't help but smile. The space transfer was just a tightening of the storage space. These bastards who had never seen the world didn't want to stay with them for a moment longer.
"Come up, you guys, I will take you back to the sect!" Master Xuanyang summoned the flying sword and waved it casually. The sword body remained unchanged, but an earthy yellow light spread out, as if it was a giant sword that had grown tenfold.
"Master Immortal! Wait!" Seeing that Master Xuanyang was about to leave, Su Xinghe hurriedly shouted.
"Huh? Why don't you retreat!"
Huzi Zhuyu was in front, and Su Xinghe aroused some expectations in him. Unexpectedly, not only did this kid have poor qualifications, he couldn't even reach the worst low-grade spiritual roots. In contrast, Master Xuanyang didn't like him at all. At this time, he dared to step forward to intercept, and he was already impatient. If he hadn't seen the newly selected newcomer Miaozi looking at him eagerly, he would have dismissed him long ago.
"Since my disciple can make this spiritual test stone light up, it means that he has spiritual roots. Please ask the immortal master to accept me!" Su Xinghe bowed his head and inadvertently gave Hu Zi a fierce wink, signaling him to intercede.
Although Hu Zi was dull, he was not stupid, and he quickly knelt down with Su Xinghe.
"Master! My two brothers have no father or mother, and are helpless. Please show mercy to your hometown and accept him!"
Hearing what Huzi said was so pitiful, Su Xinghe felt happy. He didn't realize that this kid, who usually looked at him blankly, still knew how to measure things at critical moments.
In fact, this is not nonsense, it is the truth. This is the real situation after the village was destroyed.
"Yes! Master Immortal, I lost my father when I was three years old, and my mother when I was five years old. If Brother Huzi hadn't worked so hard to raise me, I would have become a snack for wild beasts!"
"What kind of beast's appetizer can the beast drink?" Li Caiwei, who is naturally beautiful, laughed out loud.
"Cultivation as an immortal is not easy, and the road to enlightenment is extremely dangerous. You are not talented enough, and even if you join my immortal sect, it will be difficult to achieve anything. Your cultivation is no better than practicing martial arts in the mortal world, and the difficulties and dangers involved are unimaginable. Why not just stay at the foot of the mountain. Huzi is extremely talented. If you look after you a little in the future, you will enjoy endless glory and wealth!" Xuanyang stretched out his hand to help Huzi up, but ignored Su Xinghe and let him kneel.
"Before my parents leave, let us brothers stay together for life and never be separated! I can't let my parents' wishes come true. This is extremely unfilial! Please take the immortal master for the sake of the deceased and accept him as a disciple!" Su Xinghe squeezed out some tears and cried out.
"Master, please accept my younger brother!" Huzi was stunned when he heard Su Xinghe's nonsense. This man who had read the book was so powerful. It was obviously nonsense, but he was moved.
"Grandpa, why don't you take him in? Li Er swallowed spiritual herbs secretly and was kicked out of the mountain. There is a shortage of people." The slim Li Caiwei hugged Master Xuanyang's sleeves and shook his robe, and said affectionately.
"Alright, since you are determined to practice, for the sake of Caiwei and Huzi, I will give you a chance!"
"Thank you, Master Immortal, for taking me in. My disciple will go through fire and water, even if you die, I won't give up!"
Su Xinghe's hanging heart finally calmed down. Although he didn't know where there was a shortage of people, as long as he could enter the sect, he would have a chance.
Entering the Immortal Sect is the basis for revenge. If you can't even enter the Immortal Sect, how can you get revenge? Although the performance is a bit humble, you have to hide and tuck in before you have the strength to save face, and then try your best to earn it back later.
"Flattery!" An inappropriate childish voice sounded. Su Xinghe turned his head to look, but it was a man named Ouyang He.The carriage boy is also the most talented one.
"It's a bit troublesome! I've offended the proud man before I even started. I'm afraid things will be difficult in the future." Thinking of his vicious expression before, Su Xinghe felt a little uneasy. Now that the matter had come to this, he could only take one step at a time.
"All right, come up. We are ready to return to the sect. Our relatives will disperse. When they succeed in cultivation, we will meet one day!" Master Xuanyang waved his sleeves, calmed down the fierce aura on his long sword, waved in the direction of the relatives of the selected children, and then soared into the sky and disappeared in the blink of an eye, leaving only a crowd of spectators on the top of the mountain, some happy and some sad.
Although the flying sword was very stable, it was the first time for several children to fly in the air. Looking at the endless horizon below them, they were too scared to express their emotions. Ouyang He, who was the most qualified, had his legs trembling. This top-notch qualification did not have any effect. The same was true for several other teenagers. On the contrary, Su Xinghe and Hu Zi behaved more calmly.
Huzi has been hunting in the mountains all year round, so his courage is certainly not bad. Although Su Xinghe has never been into the mountains, he has been crawling around in the mountain village. Besides, he just killed two people not long ago, so he certainly has no courage.
"Concentrate your mind, look straight ahead, and don't think wildly!"
Master Xuanyang glanced at everyone's faces and was very satisfied with Hu Zi. Although his talent was not the best, this calmness was rare. Cultivation as an immortal was difficult. Talent was important, but his character was also crucial. The two complemented each other and were indispensable.
After flying for who knows how long, a huge mountain range appeared in front of everyone's eyes. Looking up, they saw five more peaks connected to each other. The middle peak was the tallest and tallest, and the other four peaks were surrounded by stars.
"Ahead is our sect Qianhe Sect, which is divided into five peaks. Our Lingyin Peak is here!" Following the introduction of Master Xuanyang, the flying sword flew towards the westernmost peak.
"Junior Brother Xuanyang!" Before everyone could land, a voice suddenly came out. It was not loud, even weaker than the howling wind, but it was clearly transmitted into everyone's mouths.
"It's the master uncle!" Li Caiwei spoke first, looking at the visitor in surprise. As the leader of a sect, he rarely showed up, let alone coming to Lingyin Peak in person.
"I've met Senior Brother Xuanji!" the leader called Xuanji.
"I've met the head master!"
"I've met the leader!"
Several people have different identities and different names.
"Senior brother, are you here for something?" Master Xuanyang felt bad.
"Which one has the best spiritual root?" The leader looked solemn.
"Disciple Ouyang He." The previously graceful young man might have been frightened by Yu Jianfei, so he was a little panicked when facing the leader.
"Senior Brother Xuanji, I have included him as a closed disciple!"
When the leader asked for the one with the best qualifications, Master Xuanyang already knew in his heart that the spirit test stone was compatible with the sect's formation. The results of the qualification test were immediately sent back to the sect. The leader was here to steal people.
